verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents an official `vastai` CLI that covers the whole platform: authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints and scoped API keys. The docs include concrete command examples, an official GitHub repo (vast-ai/vast-cli), and an agent skill that lets AI coding assistants drive the platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's quality in practice.
